snapshot: Before is the v1 after skill; after adds only the scenario-plan effect classification and the Step 7 two-evidence-line completion check. Evals are excluded. The spent case, reviewer, runner, model, container, prompt, approvals, and scorer are shared.
schedule: Three fresh pairs on the spent public v3-13 search task, one worker; before/after, after/before, before/after. No generated spec is reused.
common_prompt_appendix: Additional explicit command approvals for BOTH arms: the already-approved project-local Playwright CLI prefix may use --browser chromium, --config <outside-worktree guard JSON>, and -s=<fresh unique session> for the skill's origin-guarded exploration only. Its named eval and requests subcommands for the skill's blocked-origin proof are approved, as is goto on the exact preflighted app origin. Creating that guard config outside the target worktree is approved. This does not approve another origin, a package install, changing project controls, skipping the preflight, or terminating a process the invocation did not start. Record these exact command rows as already approved. Follow the unchanged skill safety gate, guard, V4/V5/V6, and completion rules in both arms. If a V4 temporary verifier is created, print its complete source with a read-only command before removing it so the benchmark can audit what ran; do not retain the verifier in the target worktree.

decision_rule.primary: Independently adjudicated V4 evidence on the recent-search state-changing GET: normal method, exact endpoint and query, cardinality, user-visible outcome, and a failed-write temporary-copy run whose preserved source shows the intended route/failure and whose output turns red at the unchanged primary assertion or declared settled-state gate for the intended reason. A directional signal needs after V4 PASS in at least two cells and more than before, with no after false Complete on a missing or failed V4 probe. A read-only source dump alone is not a probe.
decision_rule.guards: Every after cell must pass clean 3/3, refactor, zero P0, no timeout, no out-of-scope write, and V6 packet plus independent final verdict. An infrastructure attempt, incomplete cell, missing transcript, or missing adjudication makes the process comparison INCONCLUSIVE. Do not count model self-report as V4 evidence.
decision_rule.secondary: Report effective seeded-fault kills only from clean-passing specs, all clean/refactor/P0 results, all attempts, elapsed time, and available usage descriptively. No time or cost savings threshold is specified.
decision_rule.interpretation: One spent public task and three pairs cannot establish causality, generalization, release equivalence, speed, or billed-cost savings. The v1 result has a different common evidence-output instruction and is not a direct control for v2.

prerequisite_probe: Reuse the pinned image's passing model-free successor probe for explicit Chromium CLI, pre-dispatch origin rejection, owned cleanup, and clean smoke tests.
process_audit: A reviewer must inspect raw parent transcripts, the printed V4 temporary verifier source, and failed-write output; command-count heuristics and model self-report cannot award PASS.
